claims.claim: This is a scrap LG Flatron TV.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies it only as a small CRT television; brand/model label is not shown.

claims.claim: It is currently not functioning properly.
claims.evidence: Photo shows a dark screen; no powered-on test is shown to confirm malfunction.

claims.claim: Sold as is for parts or recycling.
claims.evidence: This is a sales/terms statement; the photos do not confirm the sale terms.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen.
claims.evidence: The witness did not show a powered-on screen image; the report only notes a dark screen.
No remote is shown in the witness photos.
No internal/repair indicators are shown; no service history is provided in the report.

risks.risk: TV may be non-functional (no picture/sound) or unstable when powered on; CRT sets often fail and a dark screen may indicate power/board issues.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the TV powered on showing a clear test pattern (or channel) with stable brightness and no shutdown/flicker, plus audible sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-working/for parts (worst case), since powered-on performance is not shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model (LG Flatron) may be incorrect or unconfirmed; wrong identification affects parts compatibility and buyer confidence.
risks.proof: Photo of the back/side label showing brand and model number (and serial if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic small CRT TV without confirmed brand/model.

risks.risk: Screen condition cannot be verified (lines, discoloration, dimness, burn-in).
risks.proof: Powered-on close-up showing full screen for lines/geometry/color balance, ideally with a grid/test image.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially defective display (worst case) despite claims.

risks.risk: Input ports may be missing or non-working (AV/antenna/SCART/other), limiting usability.
risks.proof: Photos of all visible ports plus a clip showing at least one input working (e.g., antenna or AV) with a device connected.

risks.risk: Remote may be missing or non-functional; seller claims remote included but it is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the remote control and a quick clip showing it changes channels/volume.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming remote is not included or not working.

risks.risk: Physical condition (cracks, dents, rust, stand/base security) is not shown; CRT cabinets can be damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of the full cabinet from multiple angles, including corners, stand/base, and any damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case cosmetic condition for a CRT.

proof_requests: Send a powered-on video showing picture clarity (no lines/rolling), stable brightness, and color balance.
Send a powered-on clip showing sound working (volume up/down) and that the TV doesn’t shut down or flicker.
Send a clear photo of the back/side label with brand and exact model number.
Send photos of all input ports and a short clip demonstrating at least one input working (antenna or AV).
Send a photo of the remote control and a short clip proving it controls volume/channel.
Send full cabinet photos (front, sides, back, corners) and a close-up of the stand/base for cracks/dents/rust.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a small CRT TV but the key facts needed to price it (powered-on picture/sound, remote presence/function, brand/model label, and physical condition) are not shown. Without at least a powered-on test clip, any price would be guesswork.
